# AWS Batch job execution

**Status: future extensions.** This service or extension is not implemented in the registered API profiles.
The scope below is a design candidate, without an assigned version or delivery date.

## First useful slice

Job submission, managed local Docker scheduling, attempts, logs, arrays and dependencies are implemented. Advanced scheduling and platforms remain future scope.

## Proposed scope

- [x] SubmitJob
- [x] DescribeJobs and ListJobs
- [x] CancelJob and TerminateJob
- [x] Local Docker scheduler, retries, timeouts, arrays and dependencies
- [ ] Scheduling policies and fair-share queues
- [ ] Consumable resources
- [ ] Fargate, Spot, EKS and advanced job definitions
- [ ] Job-role credentials and distributed capacity

## Integration decisions

batch.jobs: docker reuses the ECS container runtime. Records mode leaves dependency-free jobs RUNNABLE. Interrupted attempts fail on restart and apply retry rules; only containers with this store ownership label are cleaned.
